plugins.name: boardroom
plugins.description: Whole-project review board: a panel of expert hats (architect, security, SRE, UX, product, investor, skeptic, cost) reviews a project in parallel and delivers a GO/NO-GO decision calibrated to its stage (prototype to launch), plus the cross-discipline trade-offs you must resolve.
